description: Source code for FilterBasedPlayerWorkerHandler class implementing media playback control, including initialization, seeking, writing samples, handling errors, and updating media state in a media player framework.

classes.name: FilterBasedPlayerWorkerHandler
classes.description: Handles media playback operations such as initialization, seeking, writing samples, error handling, and state updates for a media player.

methods.name: FilterBasedPlayerWorkerHandler::Init
methods.description: Initializes the handler with player and callback functions, creates media components, and sets up renderers.

methods.name: FilterBasedPlayerWorkerHandler::Seek
methods.description: Performs seek operation to a specified timestamp.

methods.name: FilterBasedPlayerWorkerHandler::WriteSamples
methods.description: Writes input buffers (audio/video) to the respective renderers.

methods.name: FilterBasedPlayerWorkerHandler::WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals end of stream for specified media type.

methods.name: FilterBasedPlayerWorkerHandler::SetBounds
methods.description: Sets the display bounds for video rendering.

methods.name: FilterBasedPlayerWorkerHandler::GetCurrentDecodeTarget
methods.description: Returns the current decode target if in decode-to-texture mode.

methods.name: FilterBasedPlayerWorkerHandler::SetMaxVideoInputSize
methods.description: Sets the maximum size for video input buffers.
